# Apple Reminders (iOS and macOS) writing back: an edit, a completion, a
# create and a delete, then "Clear completed" and a sync. Written from
# published client behaviour, not captured traffic: Reminders rewrites the
# whole object on every change, leaves out CATEGORIES and every property it
# does not show, adds X-APPLE-SORT-ORDER, sends If-Match with the ETag it
# last fetched and If-None-Match: * for a new reminder, and fetches the
# object again after a PUT answered without an ETag. Apple writes DAV: as A:.

### the tags tix shows are set in the browser
DO tag open1

### the collection before the changes
PROPFIND {assigned}
Depth: 0

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:prop><A:sync-token/><A:current-user-privilege-set/></A:prop></A:propfind>
EXPECT 207
PROP {assigned} {DAV:}current-user-privilege-set 200 <d:write-content/>
SAVE start {assigned} {DAV:}sync-token

### the reminder as Reminders last fetched it
GET {assigned}{open1}.ics

EXPECT 200
SAVEHEADER etag1 ETag
HAS CATEGORIES:ops,security

### renaming the reminder rewrites it without CATEGORIES
PUT {assigned}{open1}.ics
Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
If-Match: {etag1}

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Apple Inc.//iOS 18.0//EN
BEGIN:VTODO
UID:task-{open1}@tix
DTSTAMP:20260101T080000Z
SUMMARY:Rotate keys today
STATUS:NEEDS-ACTION
PRIORITY:0
X-APPLE-SORT-ORDER:742
END:VTODO
END:VCALENDAR
EXPECT 204
LACKS ETag
TASK open1 title Rotate keys today
TASK open1 tags ops,security

### the object fetched again keeps Apple's sort order
GET {assigned}{open1}.ics

EXPECT 200
HAS SUMMARY:Rotate keys today
HAS X-APPLE-SORT-ORDER:742
SAVEHEADER etag2 ETag
DIFFERENT etag1 etag2

### a second PUT with the first ETag is stale
PUT {assigned}{open1}.ics
Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
If-Match: {etag1}

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
BEGIN:VTODO
UID:task-{open1}@tix
SUMMARY:An older edit
END:VTODO
END:VCALENDAR
EXPECT 412
TASK open1 title Rotate keys today

### ticking the reminder off
PUT {assigned}{open1}.ics
Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
If-Match: {etag2}

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Apple Inc.//iOS 18.0//EN
BEGIN:VTODO
UID:task-{open1}@tix
DTSTAMP:20260101T081000Z
SUMMARY:Rotate keys today
STATUS:COMPLETED
COMPLETED:20260101T081000Z
X-APPLE-SORT-ORDER:742
END:VTODO
END:VCALENDAR
EXPECT 204
TASK open1 status done
TASK open1 tags ops,security

### a new reminder in the Infra list
PUT {infra}8F4A61C2-1E1B-4C0B-9A3E-5B7D2C1A0F11.ics
Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
If-None-Match: *

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Apple Inc.//iOS 18.0//EN
BEGIN:VTODO
UID:8F4A61C2-1E1B-4C0B-9A3E-5B7D2C1A0F11
DTSTAMP:20260101T082000Z
CREATED:20260101T082000Z
SUMMARY:Call the bank
DUE;VALUE=DATE:20260115
X-APPLE-SORT-ORDER:743
BEGIN:VALARM
ACTION:DISPLAY
DESCRIPTION:Reminder
TRIGGER;VALUE=DATE-TIME:20260115T080000Z
X-WR-ALARMUID:0B8C6F1E-4D3A-4B53-8E7A-2F6C1D9A3B44
END:VALARM
END:VTODO
END:VCALENDAR
EXPECT 201
TASK Call_the_bank due 2026-01-15T00:00Z
TASK Call_the_bank status todo

### the new reminder fetched by its own name keeps its UID and alarm
GET {infra}8F4A61C2-1E1B-4C0B-9A3E-5B7D2C1A0F11.ics

EXPECT 200
HAS UID:8F4A61C2-1E1B-4C0B-9A3E-5B7D2C1A0F11
HAS TRIGGER;VALUE=DATE-TIME:20260115T080000Z
HAS DUE;VALUE=DATE:20260115

### deleting an open reminder
DELETE {assigned}{open2}.ics

EXPECT 204
TASK open2 status cancelled
TASK open2 trashed false

### Clear completed deletes every finished reminder
DELETE {assigned}{done}.ics

EXPECT 204
TASK done status done
TASK done trashed false

### the sync after the changes
REPORT {assigned}
Depth: 0

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token>{start}</A:sync-token><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
EXPECT 207
PROP {assigned}{open1}.ics {DAV:}getetag 200 "
STATUS {assigned}{open2}.ics 404
